name: genai_desk

A student desk seen from the side: an open paper notebook, a small stack of colourful paper books, a desk lamp — and a warm amber paper orb hovering just above the notebook, lighting the page. The student, an abstract paper silhouette seen from behind, writes in the notebook with a pencil. Wide 16:9 composition, one off-centre focal point, rising diagonal energy. NO text, NO logos, NO signage, NO photorealism.
